g.text: 1. Yadro atrofida aniq chegarali, notekis bo‘shliq (halo).

text.style: font-size: 9.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #153e37

g.text: 2. Kattalashgan, konturi notekis, to‘q yadro; chetda zich sitoplazma.

text.style: font-size: 9.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #153e37

g.text: Faqat halo yetarli emas: yadro atipiyasi ham bo‘lishi kerak.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #58756a

g.text: Manba: S4 | Masshtab va ranglar shartli
